description: This file defines configuration functions for testing an extension module related to Mattermost using Vitest. It sets up include patterns and creates a scoped Vitest configuration based on environment variables and predefined roots.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for Vitest from environment variables or defaults to an environment variable 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE'.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig( createExtensionMattermostVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the Mattermost extension using include patterns and specific test setup configurations.
